purpose: Collect verified extraction examples and compare a prior-answer-plus-diagnostic repair package with fresh retry on genuine original high-effort Sol value failures. Frozen models; no training or downstream training destination.

model.snapshot_limit: Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.
model.resolution_note: The actual requested alias and high CLI flag are retained in every full hashed request. A dated immutable model snapshot is not established by this subscription CLI.

cli_version_source: Preserved earlier run provenance; full actual CLI options are cached per request

sources.origin: Fresh programmatically generated fictional procurement packets; models do not write the source packets.
sources.date_filter: All packets postdate the documented 2026-04-30 Sol cutoff.
sources.limitations: Clean fictional tables with explicit local rules, active statuses, no OCR or missing material, and shared scenario templates.

main_dispatch.pilot: Completed serial 23-high-v4d calibration remains frozen; no pilot requests are dispatched by this helper

protocols.audit_boundary: Potential audit packets are validated up front but audit answers are called only after failure selection is frozen and never affect expansion, selection, or repairs

paired_value_recovery.caveat: Case-paired descriptive inference conditional on pilot and failure selection; shared templates can violate independent-case assumptions. A small or degenerate interval is not proof of equivalence.

paired_accepted_recovery.caveat: Case-paired descriptive inference conditional on pilot and failure selection; shared templates can violate independent-case assumptions. A small or degenerate interval is not proof of equivalence.

paired_value_recovery.caveat: Case-paired descriptive inference conditional on pilot and failure selection; shared templates can violate independent-case assumptions. A small or degenerate interval is not proof of equivalence.

actual_main.contrast: Repair package including the original answer and failed-field flags versus fresh retry; this does not isolate feedback from prior-answer exposure.

cost_note: All physical CLI attempts, including 31 archived service-history requests, remain in the denominator. Missing/interrupted usage is unknown, not zero. Token components can overlap and must not be added twice. Subscription CLI dollar billing is unavailable.
retry_boundary: One CLI subprocess per cached request, no orchestration retries. Internal CLI network retries and exact inference draw counts are not independently disabled or guaranteed; observed reconnect/error events are preserved. Parallel main dispatch stops before the next bounded wave on any transport failure.

core_freeze.preflight: 32 potential pilot packets passed procedural/Decimal, grouped/Fraction, independent text/SQL/Decimal and independent text/Fraction checks. Main sources require fresh audits before main calls.
core_freeze.call_boundary: One CLI subprocess per request, no wrapper retries. Internal CLI network retries cannot be independently disabled or verified.
core_freeze.restart_reason: Whole pilot restarted after systemic429 service failure, without using previous outputs to select cases or difficulty. Prior28requests retained underdata/high_v4_service_attempt.
changes_from_original_freeze: Abort sequential phase immediately on first transport failure; retain exact failed attempt
core_freeze.test_scope: 17fixturetests plus12transport/engine tests including service-stop and terminal-completion checks

source_freeze.source_gate: Independent exact rendered-text audit passed all264 stored packets with no key/evidence mismatch; hashes match pre-call full1056 audit.

source_snapshot_note: Frozen collection scripts and posthoc authoring scripts are preserved as source provenance. Some collector/audit defaults are authoring-relative and are not portable launchers from this snapshot. Use the self-contained notebook for reproduction. The four test modules and their helper dependencies are colocated here for local unittest execution.

tests.counting_note: 17 fixture tests + 12 transport/serial-engine tests + 5 parallel tests. The combined17-test dispatch suite includes the same12 core tests; they are counted once.

rights_note: Code and narrative follow the repository MIT license. Model responses are identified as generated service outputs. This demonstration makes no claim of unrestricted permission to use exported responses for training other models.
historical_preservation: Previous v1, hard_v2, sol_v3 and archived high-v4 service files remain untouched. This package writes only high_v4 provenance, test summary, source snapshots and review copies.
